cards.example_en: Mr Zhao is in charge of the lab.
cards.example_zh: 赵老师主管实验室。

cards.example_en: In contrast to last year, the hall is full.
cards.example_zh: 与去年形成对照，大厅坐满了。

cards.example_en: Most voters are in favor of the plan.
cards.example_zh: 大多数投票者赞成这项计划。

cards.example_en: The committee is in favour of a later start.
cards.example_zh: 委员会赞成推迟开始。

cards.example_en: A dog sat in front of the gate.
cards.example_zh: 一只狗坐在大门前面。

cards.example_en: They held a talk in honor of the coach.
cards.example_zh: 他们举行座谈，为向教练致敬。

cards.example_en: A cup was named in honour of the poet.
cards.example_zh: 一只奖杯以诗人的名字命名，为向他致敬。

cards.example_en: The result is in line with our notes.
cards.example_zh: 结果与我们的笔记相一致。

cards.example_en: They planted a tree in memory of the teacher.
cards.example_zh: 他们种了一棵树以纪念那位老师。

cards.example_en: The plant is in need of water.
cards.example_zh: 这株植物需要水。

cards.example_en: Tea was served in place of coffee.
cards.example_zh: 用茶取代了咖啡。

cards.example_en: She is in possession of the only key.
cards.example_zh: 她持有那把唯一的钥匙。

cards.example_en: In regard to fees, please ask the office.
cards.example_zh: 谈及费用，请问办公室。

cards.example_en: We discussed cost in relation to quality.
cards.example_zh: 我们讨论了费用相对于质量的问题。

cards.example_en: In respect of time, the plan is tight.
cards.example_zh: 就时间来说，这个计划很紧。

cards.example_en: They left at dawn in search of the trail.
cards.example_zh: 他们黎明出发，为了寻找那条小路。

cards.example_en: She stayed calm in the face of questions.
cards.example_zh: 面对着提问，她保持冷静。

cards.example_en: Sleep matters in the long run.
cards.example_zh: 从长远来看，睡眠很重要。

cards.example_en: The bus is late. Read in the meantime.
cards.example_zh: 公交车晚了。在此期间读会儿书。

cards.example_en: They searched in vain for the ticket.
cards.example_zh: 他们找那张票，白费了力气。

cards.example_en: I sit next to the window.
cards.example_zh: 我坐在窗户旁边。

cards.example_en: The match stopped on account of the rain.
cards.example_zh: 比赛由于下雨停了。

cards.example_en: I speak on behalf of the whole class.
cards.example_zh: 我代表全班发言。

cards.example_en: He left the note on purpose.
cards.example_zh: 他故意留下那张纸条。

cards.example_en: We decide on the basis of the evidence.
cards.example_zh: 我们根据证据做决定。

cards.example_en: She was on the point of leaving.
cards.example_zh: 她正要离开。

cards.example_en: The keys are on top of the dictionary.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙在词典上面。

cards.example_en: She walked out of the lecture hall.
cards.example_zh: 她从讲堂里走出来。

cards.example_en: This map is out of date.
cards.example_zh: 这张地图过时了。

cards.example_en: The printer is out of order.
cards.example_zh: 打印机出故障了。

cards.example_en: His courage is out of question.
cards.example_zh: 他的勇气毫无疑问。

cards.example_en: We stood out of respect for the speaker.
cards.example_zh: 我们出于对演讲者的尊敬站了起来。

cards.example_en: A free weekend is out of the question.
cards.example_zh: 有一个空闲的周末绝不可能。

cards.example_en: He is out of touch with the old club.
cards.example_zh: 他与原来的社团不联系。

cards.example_en: The fire is under control now.
cards.example_zh: 火势现在处于控制之下。

cards.example_en: The room holds up to forty chairs.
cards.example_zh: 这个房间最多可放四十把椅子。

cards.example_en: With regard to homework, ask Ms Chen.
cards.example_zh: 对于作业问题，请问陈老师。

cards.example_en: With respect to cost, the second plan wins.
cards.example_zh: 就费用而言，第二个计划更好。

cards.example_en: Please reply without delay.
cards.example_zh: 请不得拖延，尽快回复。

cards.example_en: Students need access to the library.
cards.example_zh: 学生需要接触图书馆的机会。

cards.example_en: Addiction to games can hurt sleep.
cards.example_zh: 对游戏的沉迷会伤害睡眠。

cards.example_en: Practice gives you an advantage over guesswork.
cards.example_zh: 练习给你胜过瞎猜的优势。

cards.example_en: She shows real affection for the choir.
cards.example_zh: 她对合唱团流露出真正的喜爱之情。

cards.example_en: He feels an affinity with sea poems.
cards.example_zh: 他对写海的诗有亲近感。

cards.example_en: The story describes allegiance to a promise.
cards.example_zh: 故事描写了对一项承诺的效忠。

cards.example_en: Her ambition for medicine started early.
cards.example_zh: 她对医学的抱负开始得很早。

cards.example_en: Anger at the delay filled the room.
cards.example_zh: 对延误的怒气充满了房间。
